name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Supreme Court continues to allow construction of Trump's White House ballroom
changes.summary: The Supreme Court divided 5-4 in allowing construction of the new White House ballroom to continue.

changes.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigning after friction with Hegseth
changes.summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is resigning, the White House confirmed.

changes.title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
changes.summary: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.

changes.title: Justices give Trump major legal victory on ballroom project
changes.summary: A majority of Supreme Court justices ruled that construction can continue on President Trump’s White House ballroom, which also features a secure underground facility. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

changes.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll submits resignation to White House
changes.summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is expected to step down in the coming days after the White House accepted his resignation, according to three U.S. officials. Driscoll has served in the role since February 2025 and has been a close associate of Vice President JD Vance. NBC News' Gordon Lubold reports.

changes.title: News Wrap: Supreme Court allows Trump ballroom construction to continue amid challenges
changes.summary: In our news wrap Monday, the Supreme Court is allowing construction to continue on President Trump's White House ballroom project as legal challenges play out, the Metropolitan Museum of Art is canceling a planned Met Gala exhibit on British designer John Galliano following a backlash and soccer superstar Lionel Messi.

changes.title: US supreme court allows Trump to keep building $400m White House ballroom
changes.summary: Justices’ 5-4 ruling permits Trump administration appeal to block lower court order halting above-ground work A divided US supreme court has permitted Donald Trump to continue building his controversial $400m White House ballroom despite legal challenges, raising the likelihood it will be completed. changes.title: Trump dismisses concerns over conditions on long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln
changes.summary: Reports from sailors and their families describe concerning conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. The ship has been at sea since last November, a record-length deployment. White House correspondent Liz Landers reports.

changes.title: Feds probe 'mention markets' amid White House Kalshi controversy
changes.summary: Betting on what people say is becoming an increasingly popular category of prediction market sites. Now, federal officials have opened a probe examining whether those markets are a magnet for manipulators. (Image credit: Erin Hooley/AP Photo/Erin Hooley).

changes.title: Judge drops Nevada case against electors accused of forging certificate in 2020 election
changes.summary: The dismissal marks the latest setback in swing states' efforts to prosecute fake electors who tried to keep Trump in the White House after he lost to Joe Biden in 2020. (Image credit: John Locher).
